title: Self-review checklist
description: What to verify before handing work off.

rules.title: Read your own diff
rules.text: Read the full diff before finishing and remove debug code, unrelated edits and stray files.

rules.title: Think through edge cases
rules.text: Check empty, null, large, concurrent and failure inputs for every new code path.

rules.title: Check backward compatibility
rules.text: Confirm that changes to public interfaces, configs and data formats stay backward compatible.

rules.title: Stay in scope
rules.text: Flag out-of-scope problems you notice instead of fixing them inside this change.

rules.title: Summarize with evidence
rules.text: End with a short summary of what changed, how you verified it and what remains uncertain.

rules.title: State assumptions
rules.text: List assumptions you made so the reviewer can confirm them.

rules.title: Check against conventions
rules.text: Check the change against the conventions in AGENTS.md and report violations it introduces, not unrelated old ones.

rules.title: Evidence for findings
rules.text: Back each finding with the file and line and a concrete failure scenario.
